methodology.scope: GW6–8 (GW8 provisional); GW5–7 shown separately as last three completed gameweeks.
methodology.delta: Rival minus Yedtsuna. Base = one multiplier for each scoring player; captain = multipliers above one; hit = our cost minus rival cost. No hypothetical autosubs; residual stays explicit.
methodology.ft: Reconstructed from public GW2–8 transfer counts, Wildcard/Free Hit preservation, cap 5. Next-GW moves are not public; verify 4 FT in My Team before acting.
methodology.prices: Selling value inferred from latest purchase, or GW1 launch price if never transferred. Half of price gain rounded down; losses fully applied. Bank is last deadline snapshot, not authenticated live balance.
methodology.forecast: Descriptive counts and scenarios, not calibrated probabilities. Baseline backtest predicts 0/1/2+ transfers from earlier non-WC/FH weeks only; no player prediction accuracy claimed.
methodology.elite: Current overall top 10 as of snapshot, not a random sample or proof of long-term skill; rank history and chip use shown. Historical results describe this selected cohort only.
methodology.expected: ep_next is official FPL next-event estimate, not an independently calibrated model. Transfer deltas are sums for affected squad slots, not predicted XI gain or 4-GW return. xGI is expected goals + assists, not FPL points.

forecasts.method: Conditional shortlist, not calibrated probabilities. Score all listed candidates; do not cherry-pick matches. Frozen first issue.
